budget_items.what_was_recorded: Finance Director reported total collections to date of $33,388,925.48, or 78% of FY20 estimates through 3/31/20.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: After budget adjustments the Town side would have a surplus of $982,156.32.

budget_items.topic: Pavement management and capital plan cuts
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Additional pavement management funding of $50,000 was reduced and the capital plan was cut in half.
budget_items.quote: we also reduced the additional pavement management funding of $50,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: About $3 million is held in stabilization funds, a possible source to offset a revenue reduction.
budget_items.quote: we have about $3 million in our stabilization funds.

budget_items.topic: Possible FY20 surplus-funded items (Technology, voting booths)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Technology budget and Town Clerk voting booth expenditures may be paid from FY20 surplus and removed from FY21, pending Town Meeting in June. No dollar figures printed.
budget_items.quote: the expenditure in the town clerk budget for voting booths

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Lunenburg was told it would pay double the increase in its Monty Tech assessment, partly due to enrollment. No dollar figures printed.
budget_items.quote: at that time we learned lunenburg would be paying double the increase, partially due to an enrollment increase.

budget_items.quote: we exceed that reduction if you apply what we have for a surplus to our state aid number; an almost 11% reduction.
